# Questions · BRL-tysh

## q-z8t68zd · open · blocking · by Boyd

Who is the data controller named in the privacy policy, and what is the contact address?

GDPR and Google Play require the privacy policy to name who is responsible for the data and how players reach them for deletion, access and export requests (decisions 2, 3 and 5 on this ticket). This blocks only the policy text and the web deletion page, not the in-app deletion work.

- [ ] Individual developer

  Your name (or trading name), a postal country, and a dedicated contact email such as privacy@<domain from BRL-3he3>. Give the exact values in the answer.

- [ ] A company or association

  Its legal name, registered address and a contact email. Give the exact values in the answer.
